item.title: Courtney Love Says She ‘Almost Died’ in 2019
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to Trending on Billboard! I'm your host, and today we're talking about a music legend: Courtney Love. The Hole frontwoman has just shared some exciting news with her fans, and we've got the details."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Courtney Love has announced that her long-awaited new album is finally complete. In a video posted to Instagram, she confirmed that the record is done and that she's really proud of it. But that's not all - she also opened up about a health scare that nearly killed her after moving to London in 2019."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Love didn't go into details about her illness, but she did say that her body 'exploded' and that she was frequently hospitalized. This isn't the first time she's spoken about her health struggles - in 2021, she revealed that she had nearly died from anemia the previous year."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Despite her health issues, Love is looking forward to the future of music. She praised the current state of the industry, saying that 'people sound great live' and that 'the girlies are amazing'. And don't worry, fans - she promises to be back soon."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one! Courtney Love's new album is coming soon, and we can't wait to hear it."
